column1: # Error codes (ADR 0028). code<TAB>layer<TAB>meaning<TAB>text<TAB>fix; "-" for none. Generated page: docs/errors.md (python3 scripts/errors-doc-gen.py write).
# layer run = set by the web server when a plan or start gave no status line; script = printed by a change script (refuse_code in scripts/lib/ui.sh).
# A code never changes meaning; a rename keeps the old name as an alias for one release.
